segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Stephen, full of the Holy Spirit, was dragged before the council for speaking the truth. He told them the whole story of Israel — and they boiled with rage.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: But Stephen didn't look at his accusers. He looked up, and what he saw changed everything.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He saw the glory of God — and Jesus, standing at the right hand of the Father. And he said so, out loud:

segments.speaker: scripture
segments.text: Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: They would not hear it. They rushed him out.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: But Stephen's face was the face of an angel — at peace, not afraid. The court could condemn him, but it could not make him face death alone.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Then he knelt down, with the stones still coming, and his last words asked mercy for the ones throwing them.

segments.speaker: scripture
segments.text: Lord, lay not this sin to their charge.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Don't hold this against them, he prayed. And then he fell asleep.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He saw the Son of man standing to receive him. You can face your end with that same peace.
